admission.justification: Misordered reasons and collapsed absence/collision states can hide the required repair or judge an input never present at base. Explicit source and subject boundaries preserve an actionable, comparison-bound worklist.

applicability: Shared governing-row gate reasons, stale-source observations, onboarding subject construction and base/candidate family route conditions.
conditions: A governing changed-record violation is reported before additional missing-cover details, preserving both reasons when both apply.
Unavailable recorded source blobs are named as unavailable rather than mistaken for unchanged content or absent obligations.
A root code file named overview with an existing colliding card subject refuses as incomplete rather than aliasing the root route.
A family wholly absent at the comparison base has no inherited route-condition item; its candidate routes still face validator publication checks.
exclusions: A preferred diagnostic does not waive cover completeness, currentness or the governing-row requirement.
No invented source bytes, automatic root rename, base-family fabrication, source execution or acceptance grade is introduced.
statement: Worklist and gate facts must preserve governing changed-row priority, explain unavailable source blobs, refuse a root overview collision and leave wholly new family route conditions to validator publication checks.
